key.name: meter-orientation
key.description: Automatic uses vertical colored bars and horizontal Unicode bars.

key.name: popup-opacity
key.description: Transparency percentage for the AI Usage Bar popup surface.

key.name: refresh-interval-seconds
key.description: Provider refresh interval in seconds, with a minimum of 30 seconds. Zero means manual refresh only.

key.name: merge-icons
key.description: Show one combined panel indicator instead of one indicator per provider.

key.name: compact-mode
key.description: Use denser spacing in the popup.

key.name: enabled-providers
key.description: Provider identifiers enabled in the popup and refresh loop.

key.name: openrouter-api-key
key.description: API key for OpenRouter balance and usage queries. Leave empty to disable.
